## Today’s NFL transactions briefing

### Trade
- **Saints acquired RB Zamir White from the 49ers.**  
  **Impact:** New Orleans adds backfield depth; San Francisco clears a running back spot. Worth watching for how quickly White fits into the Saints’ RB rotation.

### Free agent signings
- **Steelers signed Jaylon Guilbeau.**  
  **Impact:** Depth addition for Pittsburgh; specific role is not specified.
- **Texans signed George Odum.**  
  **Impact:** Houston adds experienced depth; exact role is not specified.
- **Texans signed Deuce Vaughn.**  
  **Impact:** Another backfield/skill-depth addition for Houston; worth monitoring for roster competition.
- **Rams signed Steven Gilmore.**  
  **Impact:** Los Angeles adds roster depth; exact position is not specified.
- **Patriots signed Matt Haack.**  
  **Impact:** New England adds a specialist option; could affect the punter competition.
- **Lions signed Jason Taylor II.**  
  **Impact:** Detroit adds depth in the secondary/defensive backfield mix; exact position is not specified.
- **Eagles signed Jaylen Mahoney.**  
  **Impact:** Philadelphia adds depth; exact role is not specified.

### Reserve/Injured designations
- **Jaguars placed Devon Marshall on Reserve/Injured from Waived/Injured; not against 90.**  
  **Impact:** Jacksonville keeps Marshall in the system without counting him against the 90-man limit.
- **Jets placed Nathan Voorhis on Reserve/Injured from Waived/Injured; not against 90.**  
  **Impact:** Same effect for New York: retained on injured status without a 90-man roster charge.

### Waivers and releases
- **Steelers waived Laith Marjan (terminated via waivers).**  
  **Impact:** Pittsburgh opens a roster spot.
- **49ers waived Tanner McLachlan (no recall).**  
  **Impact:** San Francisco clears depth at the position; McLachlan is exposed to the market.
- **Dolphins waived OL Jim Bonifas (no recall).**  
  **Impact:** Miami trims offensive line depth.
- **Dolphins waived CB Ahmari Harvey (no recall).**  
  **Impact:** Miami clears a spot in the secondary.
- **Giants waived WR Ryan Miller (no recall).**  
  **Impact:** New York reduces receiver depth heading toward roster cut decisions.
- **Lions waived Kye Robichaux with an injury settlement.**  
  **Impact:** Detroit parts ways while resolving the injury status financially.
- **Texans waived WR Jha'Quan Jackson (no recall).**  
  **Impact:** Houston trims receiver depth.
- **Texans waived LB Marte Mapu (injured, prior to cut to 53).**  
  **Impact:** Houston clears a spot while handling an injured player before final roster reduction.
- **Rams waived LB Daniel Rickert (injured, prior to cut to 53).**  
  **Impact:** Los Angeles opens a roster spot in advance of cutdowns.
- **Browns waived Tyron Herring with an injury settlement.**  
  **Impact:** Cleveland frees a roster spot and closes out the injury situation.
- **Vikings waived CB Tyreek Chappell (injured, prior to cut to 53).**  
  **Impact:** Minnesota trims secondary depth before roster cutdown.
- **Patriots waived CB Kenneth Harris (no recall).**  
  **Impact:** New England clears a defensive back roster spot.
- **49ers waived Titus Leo with an injury settlement.**  
  **Impact:** Another roster-clearing move for San Francisco tied to an injured player.
- **Chiefs waived WR Jeff Caldwell (injured, prior to cut to 53).**  
  **Impact:** Kansas City reduces receiver depth ahead of the 53-man deadline.
- **Cardinals waived WR Bryson Green (no recall).**  
  **Impact:** Arizona trims the wide receiver room.
- **Cardinals waived TE Baylor Cupp (no recall).**  
  **Impact:** Arizona clears tight end depth.
- **Cardinals waived Austin Keys with an injury settlement.**  
  **Impact:** Another Cardinals roster spot opens while settling an injury case.
- **Eagles waived RB Ja'Quinden Jackson (injured, prior to cut to 53).**  
  **Impact:** Philadelphia reduces running back depth before final cuts.
- **Raiders terminated WR Noah Brown’s contract (vested veteran).**  
  **Impact:** Las Vegas moves on from a veteran receiver; notable because vested veterans can quickly draw interest elsewhere.
- **49ers terminated TE Josiah Deguara’s contract (vested veteran).**  
  **Impact:** San Francisco frees a veteran roster spot at tight end.
- **Eagles terminated S J.T. Gray’s contract (vested veteran).**  
  **Impact:** Philadelphia parts with a veteran safety, which could affect special teams depth.

## What matters most
- **Houston was especially active:** signings of George Odum and Deuce Vaughn, plus waivers of Jha'Quan Jackson and Marte Mapu.
- **San Francisco made multiple moves:** traded Zamir White away, then also cut Tanner McLachlan, Titus Leo, and Josiah Deguara.
- **Veteran terminations stand out:** Noah Brown, Josiah Deguara, and J.T. Gray are the most established names to watch for follow-up interest elsewhere.
- **This was a cutdown-style day:** many of the waived/injured and injury-settlement moves are about clearing space ahead of roster deadlines.

**Today’s NFL injury briefing**

**Major changes**
- **Texans DE Dylan Horton** is feared to be done for the year after being helped off practice. The reports conflict on the exact diagnosis (**torn Achilles vs. torn ACL**), but the takeaway is season-ending concern. Houston’s edge depth is already thinner with **Domonique Robinson (calf)** and **Jadeveon Clowney (lower leg)** sidelined.
- **Browns DE Alex Wright** is out for the season with a torn Achilles. **Isaiah McGuire** has moved into the starting role.
- **Center Danny Pinter** is now being treated as season-ending.
- **Saints RB Ty Chandler** suffered a knee injury against the Rams that is feared serious and could keep him out a while.

**Newly listed / updated statuses**
- **Lions WR Cedrick Wilson Jr.** and **RB Raheem Blackshear** were placed on injured reserve after Wilson’s leg injury in the preseason win over Washington.
- **Texans rookie LB Wade Woodaz** had surgery to repair a broken thumb. He’s out this week, then will work toward a cast-based return plan for the season opener vs. the Bills.
- **Saints CB Rejzohn Wright** will have hip surgery.
- **Cardinals S Dadrion Taylor-Demerson** is day-to-day with a rib injury.
- **Browns WR Isaiah Bond** is in concussion protocol.
- **Chris Oladokun** is in concussion protocol after symptoms yesterday.
- **Ravens DT Nnamdi Madubuike** still has no definitive Week 1 timetable, though the update says he’s improving day to day.

**Returning / trending back**
- **Chiefs G Trey Smith** is back after dealing with a hip injury.
- **Ravens WR Xavier Guillory** returned after briefly leaving practice.

**What to watch**
- Whether **Horton**, **Pinter**, and **Wright** end up on IR and how their teams replace the snaps.
- **Ty Chandler’s** timeline, which could reshape New Orleans’ backfield.
- **Madubuike’s** Week 1 availability.

Sources: Texans defensive end Dylan Horton tore Achilles By Aaron Wilson Texans veteran defensive end Dylan Horton suffered a serious injury Monday morning, a torn Achilles tendon, according to four league sources. "He's going through it," a source said. "Tore his Achilles." This is a tough development for Horton and a Texans defense already dealing with injuries. Horton was likely going to be the Texans' fourth defensive end on the depth chart behind All-Pro edges Will Anderson Jr. and Danielle Hunter and three-time Pro Bowl selection Jadeveon Clowney. Horton, a lymphoma survivor who previously won the Ed Block Courage award in balloting from his teammates, got hurt during the latter portion of practice during team drills. He was helped off the field by trainers. Horton, a 6-foot-4, 275-pound former fourth-round draft pick from TCU, has appeared in 39 career games and has recorded 55 tackles, three tackles for losses, a half-sack, one forced fumble and a fumble recovery. He was on several of the Texans' special teams units. Clowney is sidelined with a lower leg injury. It's regarded as a short-term injury "We expected Clowney to be back," Texans coach DeMeco Ryans said. "He's dealing with a lower leg injury. He'll be back soon." Defensive end Domonique Robinson is out this week with a calf injury, and defensive end-tackle Logan Hall has missed the past few practices. Solomon Byrd and Robinson are the leading candidates for the fourth defensive end role, unless Hall slides outside. The Texans previously made trade inquiries regarding Horton, Robinson and Byrd with the San Francisco 49ers, per a league source. More movement could unfold at the position heading into the roster cutdown to 53 players Sunday. Several players didn't practice Monday, including wide receiver Tank Dell, who hasn't suffered a setback and is working out independently in return from major knee injury, rookie linebacker Wade Woodaz, who underwent successful surgery to repair a broken thumb Monday and is expected to practice with a cast on in roughly a week, running backs Jawhar Jordan (strained hip flexor) and Noah Whittington (ankle), cornerback Collin Wright (soft-tissue injury), linebacker Jake Hansen (ankle) and tight end Brevin Jordan (knee). Running back British Brooks returned to practice from a broken hand that required surgery to repair the damage. Having wide receiver Jaylin Noel participate fully provides a boost to the passing game, in addition to trading for New England Patriots wide receiver Kayshon Boutte. Noel has recovered from a strained hamstring and a broken right pinkie finger. "Jaylin’s done a good job of bouncing back, getting back into the swing of things, just continuing to get reps to build up his stamina to get out there," Ryans said.
